title: ConvoX - Real-Time Messaging App
description: A full-stack one-to-one messaging application featuring JWT authentication, real-time message delivery, online/offline presence, and image sharing. Includes REST APIs for messaging and contact management, rate limiting, input validation, and automated welcome emails.

title: ResumeIQ - AI Resume Analysis
description: A full-stack AI-powered career platform built with the MERN stack and Google Gemini API. Analyzes resumes, identifies skill gaps, and provides job-targeted career recommendations and interview preparation insights.
